text: Hyundai Motor America is the US sales subsidiary of Hyundai Motor Company (KRX: 005380), and Hyundai's own shareholder register for the end of 2025 lists Hyundai Mobis as the largest shareholder at 22.36% and the Korean National Pension Service, the country's statutory public pension fund, as the largest outside shareholder at 7.76%, with the register noting that no government institution holds a golden share.
